Bria's Savior (21406): period "Bria is located on a farm north of the bridge near Ardee ... following the river", but the only Bria stood in the far north-west corner of Connacht, 62k away. That spot is the parthanan farm where she stands with her son Davian for The Touch of Amadan Duhb ("Bria in the back of the barn at the parthanan farm"), so she stays there and a second Bria (a copy of her row) stands beside the curmudgeon harvesters' fields north of the Ardee river crossing (Connacht 54400,42300), 1.5k from the wandering curmudgeon she sends you to kill (verify fix 2026-11-11: the first version moved the one Bria and broke the other quest's location)
